europe_now.title: EU opens channel with Meta, TikTok to tackle Ceuta migrant crisis
europe_now.summary: The EU has launched a cooperation channel with Meta and TikTok to address the migrant situation in Ceuta. This initiative aims to combat misinformation and improve coordination on migration management.

sources.headline: EU opens channel with Meta, TikTok to tackle Ceuta migrant crisis

europe_now.title: Banned Russian fuel keeps re-entering EU ports, with cargoes doubling in July
europe_now.summary: Despite sanctions, shipments of banned Russian fuel have reappeared in EU ports, with volumes doubling in July. This highlights ongoing challenges in enforcing energy restrictions on Russia.

sources.headline: Banned Russian fuel keeps re-entering EU ports, with cargoes doubling in July

top_stories.title: Drought forces water restrictions across nearly 70 percent of France
top_stories.summary: Nearly 70 percent of France is under water restrictions due to record heat and drought conditions. Authorities have implemented measures to conserve water as temperatures remain exceptionally high.

sources.headline: Drought forces water restrictions across nearly 70 percent of France

top_stories.title: Greece’s aging power grid blamed for catastrophic wildfires
top_stories.summary: Greece’s outdated electricity infrastructure has been identified as a key factor in the spread of catastrophic wildfires. Experts warn that grid vulnerabilities are exacerbating fire risks during extreme weather.

sources.headline: Greece’s aging power grid blamed for catastrophic wildfires
